entities.summary: Armenia TV, is a television channel based in Armenia. In 2012, Armenia TV became the first TV channel in Armenia to launch Full HD broadcasting. By the first half of 2020, Armenia TV was the highest rated among news, fiction movies, TV series, comedy, and music shows. Armenia TV is a television station in Yerevan, established in 1997. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
